title: Agent Swarms (Parallel Team + Verifier)
builder: 🐝 **Antigravity Tip (`/swarm`):** Building multiple parts at once? Type `/swarm` to spin up a team of named AI workers plus a built-in verifier who tests everything on a shared board!
developer: 🐝 **Antigravity Tip (`/swarm`):** Split multi-file refactors or feature + test suites across parallel named workers + `@verifier` coordinating on a live shared board.

title: Side Questions (/btw)
builder: 💬 **Antigravity Tip (`/btw`):** Have a quick question while the AI is busy building? Type `/btw` to ask on the side without interrupting your build or cluttering your main chat!
developer: 💬 **Antigravity Tip (`/btw`):** Ask code-aware, read-only Side Questions in parallel while long tasks run—keeps main conversation context clean (or press `Cmd+E` on selected terminal output).

title: Autonomous Agent Teamwork
builder: 🤝 **Antigravity Tip (`/teamwork`):** Tackling a big project? Type `/teamwork` so specialized AI teammates can research, design, and code side-by-side!
developer: 🤝 **Antigravity Tip (`/teamwork`):** Delegate parallel subagent worktrees without polluting your primary context window.

title: Interactive Idea Interview (/grill-me)
builder: ✨ **Antigravity Tip (`/grill-me`):** Not 100% sure how your app should work yet? Type `/grill-me` and the AI will interview you step-by-step to turn your rough idea into a crisp plan!
developer: ✨ **Antigravity Tip (`/grill-me`):** Run `/grill-me` before coding to resolve architectural ambiguities upfront and eliminate expensive refactoring loops.

title: Context Hygiene (/compact)
builder: 🧹 **Antigravity Tip (`/compact`):** Long chat getting slow? Type `/compact` to neatly summarize earlier messages—it keeps your progress while cutting memory clutter by ~70%!
developer: 🧹 **Antigravity Tip (`/compact`):** Around 20–25+ turns, run `/compact` to compress history, prevent context rot, and preserve model quota.

title: Deep Reasoning & Verification (/boost)
builder: 🧠 **Antigravity Tip (`/boost`):** Stuck on a tricky bug? Type `/boost` to give the AI extra deep-thinking power to double-check every angle before fixing it!
developer: 🧠 **Antigravity Tip (`/boost`):** Trigger `/boost` for hard root-cause debugging, multi-perspective design reviews, and rigorous verification.

title: Live Browser Verification (/browser)
builder: 🌐 **Antigravity Tip (`/browser`):** Want the AI to actually *see* and click through your web app? Type `/browser` to visually test your live UI!
developer: 🌐 **Antigravity Tip (`/browser`):** Verify live DOM state, responsive layouts, and interactive user flows directly inside Antigravity's built-in browser.

title: Step-by-Step Planning (/plan)
builder: 🗺️ **Antigravity Tip (`/plan`):** Before diving into a big change, type `/plan` to review a simple, visual blueprint first so there are zero surprises!
developer: 🗺️ **Antigravity Tip (`/plan`):** Generate an executable implementation plan artifact to review diffs and edge cases before any files are mutated.

title: Persistent Memory (/learn)
builder: 🎓 **Antigravity Tip (`/learn`):** Just taught the AI how you like things set up? Type `/learn` so it remembers that preference forever across future projects!
developer: 🎓 **Antigravity Tip (`/learn`):** Persist non-standard project setups, lint fixes, or agent corrections as reusable rules for future conversations.

title: Interactive MCP Apps & Marketplace

developer: 🛒 **Antigravity Tip (MCP Apps & Marketplace):** Install verified namespaced plugins via `/plugin` or build MCP tools that render interactive HTML UI directly in chat & side panels.

title: Scheduled Background Automations
builder: ⏰ **Antigravity Tip (`/automation`):** Want recurring help like daily repo digests or morning summaries? Type `/automation` to put Antigravity on autopilot!
developer: ⏰ **Antigravity Tip (`/automation`):** Configure recurring cron jobs and delayed triggers with reactive wakeups via `/automation` or `/schedule`.

title: Remote Agents on Web & Mobile
builder: ☁️ **Antigravity Tip (Antigravity Web):** Keep coding from any browser or phone at `antigravity.google.com`—Remote Agents keep running your tasks even when your laptop is closed!
developer: ☁️ **Antigravity Tip (Remote Agents):** Launch isolated cloud-hosted agent sessions from `antigravity.google.com` or connect back to your local machine via Remote Control.
